failure_modes.name: spreader_impeller_wear_jam
failure_modes.symptoms: uneven granular spread; impeller stall under wet seed; motor overcurrent; reduced throw distance
failure_modes.mitigation: clean hopper after each use; replace impeller ~100h; keep granules dry; lubricate bearing

failure_modes.name: nozzle_pump_clog
failure_modes.symptoms: uneven spray pattern; reduced flow rate; under-dose streak; pump pressure-low alarm
failure_modes.mitigation: flush lines with water post-sortie; inline strainer; nozzle replacement ~50h; correct dilution

failure_modes.name: battery_fade
failure_modes.symptoms: reduced flight time; cell-imbalance warning; faster charge heat; early low-battery RTH
failure_modes.mitigation: cap fast-charge cycles; weekly balance charge; 50% SOC storage; retire below 80% capacity

failure_modes.name: chemical_corrosion
failure_modes.symptoms: oxide deposits on frame; sticky hinges; corroded fasteners; bracket loosening
failure_modes.mitigation: rinse after chemical use; anti-corrosion treatment; monthly torque audit

failure_modes.name: rtk_drift
failure_modes.symptoms: position drift >10cm; NTRIP fix lost; zig-zag path; swath misalignment
failure_modes.mitigation: verify base-station health; redundant NTRIP; antenna reposition; re-survey on float
